steps.what: Define avionics modification connections and layout against the applicable aircraft configuration
Operate CAD templates to construct repeated symbols, connections and drawing annotations
Check modification drawings against source requirements and submit the exact checked revision for engineering review

tasks.design: Configure native symbol libraries and connection-table drawing tools in the avionics CAD environment {OTHER}. The technician retains configuration reconciliation and drawing checks before engineering review; this does not approve installation or release an aircraft.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated drawing construction duplicated explicit connection and annotation decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates can render specified connections and repeated components without generating design decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Correct-looking connections may still be inappropriate for an aircraft variant or modification basis.
tasks.human_edge: The technician checks applicability, source consistency and unresolved interface issues.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated drafting; engineering and aircraft release authority remain with their existing owners.

reach.learn: Present exact configuration applicability and unresolved interface constraints.

evidence.claim: Native CAD templates and connection-table drafting are model knowledge; no digest case establishes avionics design correctness or labour savings.

assumptions: Boundary is technician drafting and checked engineering submission, excluding formal modification approval, installation, certification and aircraft release.

In s1 technician produces aircraft/configuration IDs, requirement revisions, equipment IDs, connector and pin endpoints, wire identifiers, symbol types, layout dimensions, units and source references. All capture and applicability checking are counted; unsupported geometry or missing connections return to manual drafting.
OTHER means avionics CAD environment. Test native library and table features before custom code; existing automatic drawing generation creates no new saving.
unknowns: Current CAD capability and repetitive drafting share
Configuration record quality and actual technician design scope
research_questions: Can independent review expose a wrong aircraft variant, reversed connector endpoints and stale equipment references?

already_counted.description: Configuration reconciliation and independent drawing checks remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain checked symbols, mappings and representative regression drawings.
CAD administrator maintains controlled libraries and access.

approvals.approved_version: Exact drawing, input specification and aircraft configuration revisions; changes require renewed technician checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=80 gross=20 net=12 after 8 upkeep. Zero if drawings are already template-generated or require unique layouts; 3 for a modest repeated connection and annotation subset with unchanged engineering review.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Repeated avionics drawing construction may shrink while configuration checks and engineering review remain intact.
reach: Coordinate aircraft applicability and interface questions with avionics engineers.
role.ambitious_version: A technician who derives repeated drawing details from checked records and makes applicability limits clear to engineering reviewers.
